scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -r global pages database index.html dist/ && cp _headers _redirects manifest.json dist/ 2>/dev/null || true && npx -y rollup global/js/main.js --file dist/bundle.js --format es && npx -y javascript-obfuscator dist/bundle.js --output dist/global/js/main.js --compact true --self-defending true && npx -y javascript-obfuscator global/js/security.js --output dist/global/js/security.js --compact true --self-defending true && find dist/database dist/pages -type f -name '*.js' -delete && find dist/global/js -type f -name '*.js' ! -name 'main.js' ! -name 'security.js' -delete && rm -f dist/bundle.js
